lines.text: Many learners say: Where you are going?
In questions, put are before you.
Are you! Where are you from?

data.why: In questions, put are before you.

native.tip: En preguntas el verbo va antes del sujeto: “Where are you going?”.
native.caption: En español “¿adónde vas?”, pero en inglés el verbo auxiliar va antes 🧭 Di “Where are you going?”, no “Where you are going?”. ¡Escucha a Carlos y repite! Practica más en la app Lexkite.
native.comment: Respuesta: “are you”. Pregunta + verbo + sujeto. Practica más con un quiz gratis aquí: {link}

en.tip: In questions the verb goes before the subject: “Where are you going?”.
en.caption: In Spanish “¿adónde vas?”, but in English the helper verb comes first. Say “Where are you going?”, not “Where you are going?”. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
